message.content: For a birthday party on Saturday night, these white leather sandals with a block heel and slingback strap are an excellent choice—they’re neat but playful enough for celebration. Pair them with dark jeans or black trousers to keep your look grounded, or go lighter with a crisp blouse if you want something fresher. They’ll stand out nicely without overpowering your outfit, making you feel put-together yet fun for the occasion.
